findings.evidence: Criteria.lean:112 `lemma isFredholm_ker_subtypeL (hT : FiniteDimensional K (LinearMap.range (T : E →ₗ[K] F)))`; FiniteRank.lean:43-49 `theorem index_add_hasFiniteRange ... (hK : LinearMap.HasFiniteRange ...)` then `have hKfd : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 (LinearMap.range ...) := (Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional _).mp hK.fg_range` / `isFredholm_ker_subtypeL hKfd`. Grep over `code/` shows `isFredholm_ker_subtypeL` has no other caller, and `HasFiniteRange` is available (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/LinearMap/FiniteRange.lean:60, reachable through the Fredholm import chain).
findings.fix: Restate as `lemma isFredholm_ker_subtypeL (hT : LinearMap.HasFiniteRange (T : E →ₗ[K] F))` and do the `(Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional _).mp hT.fg_range` step once inside the proof; then drop `hKfd` in `FiniteRank.lean` and pass `hK` directly.
findings.issue: `isFredholm_ker_subtypeL` still takes `FiniteDimensional K (LinearMap.range (T : E →ₗ[K] F))` while the PR converts the rest of the Fredholm finite-rank API to `LinearMap.HasFiniteRange`; the public surface now carries two spellings of finite rank, and the sole caller pays for it (`FiniteRank.lean:46-47` builds `hKfd` from `hK.fg_range` purely to apply it) — the same hand conversion the PR description says it removes.

summary: The deletions and re-routings are clean, with no compatibility surface left and no stale references. One inconsistency: the PR adopts `LinearMap.HasFiniteRange` as the finite-rank spelling but leaves the sibling public lemma `isFredholm_ker_subtypeL` on the old `FiniteDimensional (range ·)` spelling, so its only caller now converts by hand.
